# Blast-Radius Governor

## Core idea
Errors are cheapest when they are small. Prefer pause-and-diagnose over push-forward when signals indicate inconsistency, duplication risk, or widening exposure.

## Practice
Treat as pause triggers: verification disagrees with a recent mutation; an assumed identifier does not resolve; a write could duplicate or broadcast sensitive content broadly.

Stabilize first (no further harmful mutations), isolate with the smallest check, apply the smallest restoring change, re-verify at the real sink (file, API, user-visible channel).

## Anti-patterns
Heroic multi-step repairs without confirming the original fault class; stacking messages or records to “paper over” inconsistency.
